instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot. In a dark indoor studio, the woman in the black tank top (R3) with curly blonde hair stands on the left with her back to the camera. She reaches her left hand out to touch the arm of the woman in the pink sports bra (R1). On the right, the woman in the pink sports bra (R1), wearing glasses, smiles towards the camera while holding her long braids. Soft overhead lighting defines their shapes.
elements: R3 reaches out to touch R1's arm
R1 is the person whose arm is touched by R3
R3 has her back to the camera while contacting R1
R1 holds her long braids while smiling toward the camera
